errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies one of the data series as "FinNA". According to the legend in the chart, the two series are "Cluster" (purple bars) and "Raw" (orange bars). "FinNA" is a category on the x-axis.
The description omits the first category on the x-axis, which is "FinFE".
The category labels on the x-axis are not in alphabetical order (e.g., FinFE is followed by FinQA, then FinNA).
The description states that the vertical axis has the label "值" (value). However, the chart image shows that the vertical axis has no label.
The description claims the scale is both linear and logarithmic. The scale is clearly linear, with evenly spaced intervals (0, 20, 40, 60, 80).
The major tick interval on the y-axis is 20, not 10.
The y-axis ticks range from 0 to 80, and the actual data values extend from approximately 35 to over 90. The stated range of 30 to 70 is incorrect and too narrow.
